purpose: Freeze Campaign121's sole endpoint first-attainment definition, source, ordered no-return gates, complete finite comparison boundary, one development trial, execution assumptions and stop rules before opening any Campaign121 value.

candidate.name: intraday_terminal_close_direction_first_attainment_240m
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Earlier attainment of the session's eventual directional close level represents earlier information acceptance and less dependence on a terminal print, potentially supporting persistence over the next three sessions.

source_grid.open_reference: raw open of the 09:31 selected bar
source_grid.terminal_reference: raw close of the 15:00 selected bar

exact_formula.direction_rule: d=+1 if close_240>open_09_31, d=-1 if close_240<open_09_31, and d=0 on exact equality; use no tolerance, logarithm or return magnitude.
exact_formula.attainment_rule: For d=+1, tau=min{i in 1..240: close_i>=close_240}; for d=-1, tau=min{i: close_i<=close_240}; close_240 guarantees existence.
exact_formula.support: Require the exact grid, one symbol and provider, finite strictly positive open_09_31 and all 240 closes; no imputation, adjustment or tolerance.

comparison_contract.direction_normalization: use every comparator's frozen score direction

ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_snapshot_and_implementation_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before source values bind this protocol, pure formula implementation, tests, raw and joint-clean sources and output path. After publication verify every partition byte/frame hash, exact open-close-only projection/grid/formula/support/range/count and aggregate dataset digest.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, all values in [0,1], and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Failure stops before comparator, daily-price or forward-return values.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_138_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v113 numeric order with all 138 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.purge: Purge three signal sessions at every train/validation boundary; t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain in the same partition.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.execution: Reuse the frozen one-factor next-open to third-close Top-3 engine, CNY 200000 board-lot pilot, quality/listing gates, amount-participation checks, 0/5/10/20bp stress grid and survivor gates without override.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025: Open once only if the sole trial survives every 2019-2023 gate and a nonzero survivor record freezes the campaign; label historically exposed quasi-out-of-sample. Otherwise keep closed and unread.
